hypotheses.title: Consensus Cash Flow Per Share Yield in Broad Market Neutrality
hypotheses.economic_rationale: Analyst consensus forward Cash Flow Per Share (anl4_afv4_cfps_median) measures organic operating cash generation per share before non-cash accruals. In Sector Neutral it scored Sharpe 1.18 and Fitness 1.00; shifting to Market Neutral frees the portfolio to allocate across high-cash-generating sectors, mirroring the structural jump seen in Alpha 1 (Sharpe 1.43, Fitness 1.51, Self-correlation 0.5768).
hypotheses.falsification_test: Alpha returns fail during systemic credit market freezes.

candidates.expression: 0.60 * signed_power(group_rank(ts_rank(ts_backfill(anl4_afv4_cfps_median, 60) / close, 180), market) - 0.5, 2) + 0.30 * group_rank(ts_mean(ts_backfill(anl4_capex_value, 252), 252) / (ts_backfill(assets, 60) + 1000), market) - 0.10 * group_rank(ts_delta(close, 5) / close, market)

hypotheses.title: Consensus Forward Book-to-Price Tangible Asset Growth
hypotheses.economic_rationale: Consensus forward Book Value Per Share (anl4_bvps_median) reflects Wall Street's forward projection of tangible net worth per share after factoring in retained earnings. Unlike historical static book value, forward BVPS captures anticipated equity compounding. Pairing forward book value yield with capex discipline isolates asset-heavy compounders expanding physical plant at disciplined reinvestment rates.
hypotheses.falsification_test: Alpha underperforms during speculative asset-light tech surges.

candidates.expression: 0.60 * signed_power(group_rank(ts_rank(ts_backfill(anl4_bvps_median, 60) / close, 180), sector) - 0.5, 2) + 0.30 * group_rank(ts_mean(ts_backfill(anl4_capex_value, 252), 252) / (ts_backfill(assets, 60) + 1000), sector) - 0.10 * group_rank(ts_delta(close, 5) / close, sector)

hypotheses.title: Options Put-Call Open Interest Sentiment Asymmetry
hypotheses.economic_rationale: The 30-day put-to-call open interest ratio (-pcr_oi_30) is an institutional options sentiment indicator. Extremely high put open interest signals excessive hedging and retail panic, setting up a structural mean-reverting squeeze. Inverting the ratio and stationarizing over a 180-day percentile rank isolates equities transitioning from peak bearish hedging to institutional accumulation.
confounders: Unusual directional hedging around binary clinical or earnings events
hypotheses.falsification_test: Alpha returns fail during protracted multi-quarter bear markets.
